{{Top}}
[[File:Camera_SWG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A camera]]
A '''camera''' was a type of device that captured light and processed it to produce a photograph, a two-dimensional representation of a specific event, which could be viewed electronically or in a hard copy format. Some cameras included a flash feature that helped add illumination to better view its subject. Small, handheld cameras were used by tourists to record their travels.

"Camera" was also used as a generic term for any device used to capture images, including holograms and video footage.

==History==
Approximately one year before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a passenger of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] interstellar traveling agency carried a camera inside their luggage. It was eventually discovered by scanners used by the security check-in droid [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], and mistaken for a type of alien weapon. The camera then activated, causing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to panic and then tell the scanner to destroy it. After learning that the device was a "camera," he was confused as to what it was as well as slightly irritated.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

In the pre-boarding video for the Star Tours' [[StarSpeeder 1000]] around the same time, a Human child also used a camera with the flash option activated at a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari passenger|Mon Calamari]] and [[Unidentified Wookiee passenger|Wookiee passenger]], disorienting them, resulting in his mother scolding him.<ref name="ST2" /> A similar incident [[4 ABY|years later]] was recorded in a safety video for Star Tours' [[StarSpeeder 3000]]s.<ref name="ST1">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

[[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] was known to use custom made [[Ree-Yees' camera|three-eyed camera]]. He enjoyed visiting other planets via Star Tours and often used the camera to take pictures, despite flash photography not being allowed.<ref name="Boarding Party">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Boarding Party|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/StarToursBoardingParty.asp}}</ref><ref name="ST Experience">{{YouTube|video=s9NP6iSAkVo|text=Star Tours (Original) - The Complete Experience|channel=channel/UC8fE3Sd7b9Gp5sTITX16uCg|name=Anthony's Channel}}</ref>
